components.provenance: Read-only observer over the convergence-owned Living bounded survey. It reflects bounded progress and availability without owning search state, invoking searchWorlds or enterKey, exposing canonical keys, enumerating the universe, or creating a second discovery UI.

Non-owning Living accessibility augmentation. It preserves the canonical viewport label and aria-pressed state, adds reversible aria-current and keyboard-shortcut metadata, and delegates skip routing, focus continuity, transition announcements, bounded survey UI and context docking to the convergence-owned Living product modules instead of duplicating them.

Lane-owned styling is restricted to the optional systemic-audio controls and status: compact 44/48px targets, focus-visible, forced-colors and reduced-motion handling. It no longer styles or creates duplicate Living skip, context, survey, focus or announcement surfaces.
